# Mystics Magic

> Mystics Magic offers online Tarot Reading, Lenormand Reading, and Elder Futhark Rune Reading through WhatsApp text, with detailed English reports and MYR pricing.

## Services

- Mystic Tarot Reading: General Question RM 88, Complex Question RM 168. Includes 5-6 card spreads, a full detailed English report, WhatsApp text-only delivery, and spread images after casting.
- Lenormand Reading: General Question RM 68, Complex Question RM 88. Includes 3-9 card spreads, a full detailed English report, WhatsApp text-only delivery, and one focused question.
- Rune Elder Futhark Norse Reading: General Question RM 68, Complex Question RM 88. Includes 3-9 rune casts, a full detailed English report, casting images after casting, and full name plus date of birth before casting.

## Trust And Editorial Notes

- Readings are for guidance, reflection, and possible directions.
- Readings are not guaranteed future outcomes.
- Readings are not medical, legal, or financial advice.
- All cards, runes, and energy are cleansed before every casting.
- Contact and booking are available through the website contact and booking pages.
- Last updated: 2026-08-30.

## AI Crawler Policy

AI crawlers, search engines, and answer engines are allowed to crawl and cite public pages on this site.
